title: Fancy Shawl Dance  HOW TO SPIN

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher introduces steps through clear breakdown and demonstration, explaining shawl construction and holding techniques before showing variations. She practices variations slowly and then demonstrates them fully to music.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces herself and the focus on shawl dancing.
Teacher explains shawl sizing and holding technique.
Teacher breaks down traveling spin on two beats.
Teacher demonstrates spin on a single beat (1-1-1).
Teacher breaks down front cross spin.
Teacher demonstrates spinning on the spot.
Teacher explains and demonstrates the grapevine move.
Teacher reviews combining all moves together.
Teacher performs the routine to music.

steps_taught.name: Single beat spin
steps_taught.description: Spin hopping from foot to foot with arms going up and down.

steps_taught.name: Front cross spin
steps_taught.description: Cross right leg over front and spin forward.

steps_taught.name: Grapevine
steps_taught.description: Walking sideways with alternating front and back foot crosses.

what_works: Clear visual demonstrations of shawl positioning and footwork
Showing both slow breakdowns and full-speed demonstrations to music
what_hinders: Demonstrations are primarily from the front angle without mirrored views

quotes.text: If you are wanting to become a powwow dancer, the very first thing you need to do is connect with your people.
If you want to make your own shawl, you want to make sure that the length or the width of your shawl... goes fingertip to fingertip.
So let's go over our traveling spin on a two beat.
So now I want to show you how to throw all those dance moves together.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher holds her arms out to measure shawl width and drapes material to demonstrate fit.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact measurements for individual body proportions

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates traveling spin on a two beat with footwork and arm extension.
Teacher steps across with the right foot and turns for the front cross spin.

extraction.distinctive_method: Combines cultural context and traditional attribution (mentioning who made her shawl) with step-by-step physical breakdown of textile handling.
